experience.headline: Professional Experience & Impact
experience.subtitle: Software engineering roles across university institutions, enterprise software development, and academic projects.

items.summary: Co-developed a KMUTT PSF self-assessment web app with one teammate, working on both the React frontend and the Go backend. Teaching staff sign in with their KMUTT account, answer an assessment on their teaching practice, and see indicative competency results.
bullets: Set up the frontend with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, including the page layout, navigation bar, routing, and a shared Axios client for API calls.
Implemented KMUTT account sign-in through the university's ADFS using MSAL, including the login callback flow.
Set up the backend in Go with Fiber, GORM, and PostgreSQL, designed the data models for assessment questions, answers, submissions, and the feedback poll, and built the question API.
Built backend authentication: verified ADFS tokens against the university's signing keys and issuer, created users on first sign-in, and issued app tokens checked by middleware on protected routes.
Added Thai and English support with i18next across the home, login, assessment, and results pages.

items.summary: Developed and maintained commercial web applications using modern full-stack frameworks, ensuring high performance, responsive styling, and code quality.
bullets: Developed and maintained web applications using modern frameworks, focusing on code quality and maintainability.
Refactored RESTful APIs to improve code structure and simplify long-term maintenance.
Conducted structured peer code reviews to maintain deterministic type definitions and prevent regressions.

items.summary: Designed and developed the official website for the international eLearning Forum Asia 2025 conference, focusing on user-friendly interface design and smooth participant navigation.
bullets: Engineered an internationalized event portal supporting speaker schedules, delegate registration, and live agenda updates.
Contributed to both frontend and backend development, utilizing React for the frontend and focusing on backend scalability and reliability under load.

items.summary: Co-developed the web platform used to run the annual 2B-KMUTT research camp, covering camper and staff records, attendance, leave, and project submissions.
bullets: Built the user directory with detail views for campers and staff, plus profile pages with an activity calendar, using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Developed the leave request flow end to end: request form with PDF evidence upload, staff review and approval screen, and the API routes behind them.
Implemented the attendance lookup API for the QR check-in system and fixed time-zone handling so check-ins record in Bangkok time.
Added admin tools for editing profiles, resetting passwords, and assigning mentors and group seniors, on a Prisma and PostgreSQL backend running in Docker.

items.summary: Designed and deployed an automated classroom booking application for university mathematics facilities and faculty coordinators.
bullets: Designed a classroom booking application using Power Apps, including UI development and implementing automated scheduling functionality with Power Fx.
Structured and integrated an Excel-based data storage system to manage classroom reservations and automate schedule conflict checks.

projects.headline: Featured Case Studies
projects.subtitle: Selected engineering case studies highlighting problem framing, system architecture, and quantifiable outcomes.

edubridge.title: EduBridge — Interactive Educational Platform with Gamification Mechanisms
edubridge.subtitle: Real-time virtual classroom where students learn through avatars, quizzes, missions, and badges, while teachers track progress with built-in analytics.
edubridge.challenge: Online classes struggle to keep students engaged and motivated, learners often feel pressured to take part, and teachers lack analytics that connect to every learning and teaching activity.
edubridge.solution: Built a real-time virtual classroom with Phaser where students join as personalized avatars to take online quizzes, complete missions, and collect rewards in a badge shop. Teachers manage courses and scores and review learning analytics at both class and individual level.
edubridge.outcome: SUS usability score of 87.08% from teachers (Excellent) and 74.53% from students (Good); 100% success rate with 40 concurrent users, and no server crash under a 2,000-user stress test.
edubridge.imageAlt: ProjectDay 2026 poster for EduBridge (CPE35): objectives, tech stack, usability and load test results, and screenshots of the virtual classroom, analytics, quizzes, missions, and badge shop.

twoB.title: 2B-KMUTT — Camp Management System
twoB.subtitle: One web platform for running the 2B-KMUTT Future Leader Camp: camper and staff records, QR attendance, leave requests, and research project submissions.
twoB.challenge: Running a multi-day research camp means tracking every camper's profile, health and emergency contacts, daily attendance, leave, and research project submissions, plus staff schedules, which is hard to keep in sync across separate spreadsheets.
twoB.solution: Built a role-based Next.js platform for admins, senior and junior staff, and campers: QR-code check-in scanned by staff, leave requests with evidence upload and approval, research project PDF submission, staff working-hour logs with Excel export, bulk import from Excel/CSV, and email password reset.
twoB.outcome: Used to run the 2B-KMUTT camp and maintained for the following year's camp; I built the user directory, profile and calendar views, the leave request and review flow, and the attendance API.
twoB.imageAlt: 2B-KMUTT Future Leader Camp (20th) login page: camp artwork on the left and an email and password sign-in form on the right.
twoB.secondaryImageAlt: Research submission check page in the 2B-KMUTT system, listing each research group with its total members, submitted, and not-yet-submitted counts.

infoscope.title: InfoScope — OSINT Investigation Workbench
infoscope.subtitle: Runs WHOIS, username, and breached-password checks for one target in a single request, and keeps the results organized by case.
infoscope.challenge: Open-source intelligence checks on a single target usually mean juggling separate tools and websites for domain lookups, username searches, and breach checks, then copying the results into notes by hand.
infoscope.solution: Developed InfoScope, a security investigation tool that gathers information from domains, usernames, and passwords in one place. Features include domain ownership lookup, username checks across multiple websites, and password exposure checks to identify credentials that may have appeared in data breaches. Uses a privacy-preserving method to minimize password exposure, stores results separately for each case, and displays findings in tables for easy analysis.
infoscope.outcome: Semi-Finalist at Cyber Warrior Hackathon 2025. Built with one teammate; I set up the project, data models, and database, wrote the WHOIS parser, and built the React pages and API hooks for results and case history.
infoscope.imageAlt: InfoScope home page: a dark header with the InfoScope name and tagline, and an Investigation Parameters form for case name, username, domain, and password with WHOIS, WhatMyName, and Have I Been Pwned options.

starthai.title: Star Thai — Massage Spa Booking & Management System
starthai.subtitle: Online booking, therapist scheduling, Stripe payments, and SMS notifications for a massage spa.
starthai.challenge: A massage spa needs customers to book several treatments in one visit with the therapist they want, without double-booking anyone, while the owner tracks payments and the day's schedule.
starthai.solution: Developed a complete massage shop management system, covering service bookings, massage selection, online payments, and cash payment records. Integrated SMS notifications for bookings and appointments, along with daily business summaries for the shop owner.
starthai.outcome: Developed end to end by me across separate backend and frontend repositories, with automated tests for the booking, payment, and notification flows. The spa’s public website is live; the booking system is being prepared for a staging deployment on AWS.
starthai.imageAlt: Star Thai home page: a dark navigation bar with Book Now, the heading “Thoughtful care, quiet calm.” with booking buttons, and an arched photo of the spa’s lounge.

Focused on improving user experience with easy-to-follow recipes and seamless ingredient ordering.

phileCinema.title: Phile Cinema Website
phileCinema.summary: Developed a movie ticket booking website with booking management.
description: Developed a movie ticket booking website as part of coursework with a system to manage user data, movie information, showtimes, and bookings using React, Express.js, and SQL for database management.
Focused on database normalization for efficient storage and retrieval of information.

mastermind.summary: Developed a decoding game to compare the efficiency

Compared the performance of both algorithms by analyzing the number of guesses required for success.
